subject: expression: use `assertionEvalContext` to check some constraints in runtime (#52141)
summary: Change is effectively test-only (guarded by `intest.InTest`): introduce `assertionEvalContext` and wrap `ScalarFunction` eval/vec-eval paths to assert (1) EvalContext vs TypeCtx timezone consistency and (2) optional eval-prop reads are declared via `RequiredOptionalEvalProps()`. Only production-impacting behavior change is a small correctness fix in `builtinSetValSig.RequiredOptionalEvalProps()` to include `SessionVarsPropReader` (previously ORed `SequenceOperatorPropReader` twice). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in expression semantics, privilege checks, or runtime/session behavior.
